title: pouteria congolensis

The tree has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria congolensis include its use as an antiseptic, expectorant, and demulcent, which can help to soothe and protect the mucous membranes, while its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic compounds, have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential side effects of using Pouteria congolensis for medicinal purposes.
